definitions: A magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) finding in the substantia nigra pars compacta, characterized by the absence of the normal swallow-tail appearance, indicative of dopaminergic neuronal loss.
An imaging biomarker for Parkinson's disease, reflecting the degeneration of specific neurons in the brain.
examples: The neurologist noted the absent swallow-tail sign on the patient's MRI.
Research is exploring the absent swallow-tail sign as an early diagnostic marker.
The presence of an absent swallow-tail sign supports a diagnosis of Parkinson's.
